documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings where revenue from operations grew 27.92% year-on-year to INR58.26 crores and profit after tax rose 25.81% year-on-year to INR8.54 crores. Management highlighted steady execution across six ongoing projects and noted the addition of a new project, Neel Kiran Society in Santacruz West, as part of their expansion in Mumbai. The company maintains an asset-light redevelopment model focused on western suburbs and neighboring areas while navigating stable demand and overcoming prior cost pressures from material and labor shortages. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 27.9% to ₹58.26 crore, EBITDA rising by 14.2% to ₹11.65 crore, and PAT increasing by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore. Management highlighted steady construction progress across key ongoing projects and the successful securing of a new redevelopment project during the quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects healthy margins of around 20% to 30% in every project.
guidance.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

guidance.claim: The company remains super confident in the growth roadmap laid for FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain super confident in the growth roadmap we have laid for FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Pricing trends have been stable with no major volatility across well-connected western suburb projects.
demand_outlook.quote: There have been no much volatility in terms of the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that RBI rate cuts have brought home loan rates to 8.1%, which is boosting housing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: RBI rate cuts: Home loan rates at 8.1%, boosting housing demand

capex_expansion.claim: The portfolio currently consists of six ongoing projects, 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with this, currently we have six ongoing projects and 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Bombay and its region, taking our portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company successfully secured another new redevelopment project during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter marked another important milestone for the Company with the successful securing of another new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired two new projects named Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 27.9% to ₹58.26 crore, EBITDA grew by 14.2% to ₹11.65 crore, and PAT rose by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore.
margins_costs.quote: “Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore, while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore and PAT rose by 25.8% to X8.54 crore, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and the strength of the Company's redevelopment-led business model.

margins_costs.claim: Margins saw some moderation due to project mix, execution, and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects.
margins_costs.quote: While margins saw some moderation due to project mix and execution and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, we believe this is temporary and our long-term margin profile remains healthy.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they are suffering minor hits on raw material costs for Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature projects.
margins_costs.quote: See, in terms oft he raw material cost, we are just minorly suffering on Rashmi Square project and Rashmi Signature.

orders_capacity.claim: The area sold in Q1 FY27 reached around 44,000 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: One number I want to specifically mention is the area sold, which in Q1 FY27, we have sold around 44,000 square feet.

orders_capacity.claim: Execution progress during the quarter included Rashmi Square completing 22 slabs and Rashmi Signature completing its 20th slab.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Square has completed 22 slabs. Rashmi Signature completed its 20th slab.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Delight completed 14 slabs and Rashmi Manorath completed 13 slabs.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Delight completed its 14th slab, and Rashmi Manorath completed its 13th slab.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 lakh is booked and 2.40 lakh is available inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains its debt-free model despite rapid growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still debt-free despite rapid growth. We continue to maintain our debt-free model.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is on hold due to a government stay across the 500-meter area.
risks_headwinds.quote: Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is a little on hold. So, projects will be going into this year, starting this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged foreign investment share dropping to 13% in Q1 2026 as a key risk and watch factor.
risks_headwinds.quote: Foreign FDI Pullback: Foreign investment share down to 13% in Q1 2026

risks_headwinds.claim: The company highlighted a 154% year-on-year surge in office launches as a supply overhang risk.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply Overhang Risk: 154% YoY surge in office launches

risks_headwinds.claim: Global trade uncertainty was noted as a headwinds factor that may impact GCC and FDI flows.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Trade Headwinds: Trade uncertainty may impact GCC & FDI flows

risks_headwinds.claim: Increased raw material costs due to the war situation impacted the company on certain projects.
risks_headwinds.quote: So in terms of the war situation has impacted us, but not majorly because currently the execution stage which is at this level, the raw material impact is at a lower level to us.

management_commitments.claim: Rashmi Paradise will start in the current quarter, Rashmi Gold and Sheetal in the third quarter, and Khar in the fourth quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The Rashmi Paradise will be starting in this quarter. Rashmi Gold and Shectal probably in the third quarter, and the Khar in the fourth quarter

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a focus on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding the redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value looking ahead.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets handing over the Rashmi Signature project to the society in the first quarter of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So we arc targeting this project Rashmi Signature to be handed over to the society in the first quarter of <27, Rashmi Delight and Rashmi Manorath both are on the verge of half of completion, both the towers arc getting completed and this we'll be targeting completion next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects margins to bounce back to previous levels.
management_commitments.quote: No, no, we'll bounce back to our previous levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to deliver Rashmi Square in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27. This year we'll be delivering Rashmi Square.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
